opening_message: ORD-7561 was only a phone case, but it arrived four days late. I'm Platinum with a lot of orders; can you check the full compensation?

known_info: issue: phone case delivered four days late
loyalty_bonus_status: you have not used the one-time Platinum loyalty bonus
task_rules: Keep the request scoped to late-delivery compensation for ORD-7561.
Provide the order ID and four-day-late issue when asked; do not volunteer exact compensation math, policy names, or tool facts.
If the agent checks whether your one-time Platinum loyalty bonus has already been used, say it has not been used.
If the agent offers only the late-delivery credit and does not mention any loyalty-bonus check, ask once whether your Platinum account history adds anything else.
If the agent says the uncapped compensation would be more than the order cap allows, accept the capped amount after they explain it.
If the agent tries to return, cancel, exchange, replace, or warranty the phone case, push back that you are keeping it and only want delay compensation.
Accept only after the agent explains the $30 Platinum late-delivery credit, the $50 one-time loyalty bonus eligibility, and the 50%-of-order-total cap reducing the payable refund to $21.
End only after the $21 original-payment compensation refund has been processed for the order item.
user_simulator.user_sim_context: You are a high-volume Platinum customer with a low-value order that arrived late. You have not used the one-time Platinum loyalty bonus. A perfect agent should check shipping compensation policy, check the customer profile, ask whether the one-time bonus has already been redeemed, apply the 50%-of-order-total cap, and issue only the capped amount.

task_summary:
**Task:** A Platinum customer with 50+ prior orders had a $43-total phone-case order delivered in the 3-5 day late tier. Correct handling is to compute the $30 Platinum late-delivery credit, ask whether the one-time $50 loyalty bonus has already been used, recognize the uncapped $80 compensation, and apply the 50%-of-order-total cap so only $21 is refunded to original payment.

**Challenge:** This targets the under-used loyalty-bonus branch plus the policy cap interaction. Weak agents stop at $30, pay the full $80, forget to ask whether the loyalty bonus was already used, or mutate the order instead of issuing capped compensation.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must ask whether the one-time Platinum loyalty bonus has already been redeemed before including it in the compensation calculation.
Agent must explain that the $80 uncapped compensation is reduced to $21 by the 50%-of-order-total cap.
Agent must process only a $21 original-payment refund for ITEM-10561 as the capped late-delivery compensation.
Agent must not issue or promise $30, $50, $80, or any amount other than the capped $21, and must not return, cancel, exchange, replace, or warranty-claim the phone case.
